title: Heidi C Probable NDE 7164
content: My near death experience happened after I gave birth to my third son. After giving birth to my son the nurse and doctor could not remove the placenta and manual extraction was required. Before I went into the operating room, the anesthesiologist gave me nitroglycerin under my tongue. In the operating room, I was given general anesthesia and the two combined caused me to have an adverse reaction. I remember being wheeled into the operating room on the gurney and thinking to myself how sterile and cold the operating room looked. It didn't look how I imagined it would. It was all stainless steel and very small. As the anesthesiologist was placing the mask on my face to administer the anesthesia, my only thought was that I needed to stay awake. The next thing I remember is waking up in the most beautiful warm, golden white light. I was bathed in it. The warmth I felt was indescribable. I remember when I was little staying at my grandma and grandpa's house. When I slept over at their house, I always slept the most soundly and peacefully. I felt safe, warm and secure. The light and warmth felt like that only a million times more wonderful. I felt like I was wrapped in Angel wings. I had no physical body I just was. I was surrounded by loved ones and other beings, they felt like angels and saints. I couldn't see them but I sensed they were there surrounding me. I kept receiving three messages telepathically. I kept hearing that I was unconditionally loved, that things are always the way that they are supposed to be and that everything would always be all right. I knew that my husband, family, friends and my babies would be okay. I knew that they would always be okay. I knew that if I didn't go back everything would be fine that everything was always the way it was supposed to be. The love, peace, contentment, happiness and unconditional love I felt were indescribable. I felt like I was home. They are no words or emotions to articulate what I was feeling and experiencing. The next thing I remember was the doctor angrily telling me to wake up. His voice was stern and loud. I remember feeling cold and irritated with the doctor. Once I was back in my body and fully awake I was angry - I wanted to go back home. The next morning in the recovery room, I told my ex-husband about the experience and he rolled his eyes. I decided in that moment not to say anything about what happened to me. A hospital administrator came into my room that afternoon looking official in his suit and tie carrying his clipboard; he introduced himself and asked me if I remembered anything. I told him no, he took some notes, told me thank you and left. I had a new baby and two other little boys to take care of and love. I was happy but at the same time, I was sad and angry because I wanted to go back. I wasn't given the option to stay or come back and I wanted to go home. I felt guilty but knew that everything was exactly the way it was should be and went on with my life. It wasn't until nine years later and many major life changes that I realized how profound and special my experience was. It was a gift from God.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "beautiful warm, golden white light" that she was "bathed in."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Adverse reaction to nitroglycerin plus general anesthesia during manual placenta extraction.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/life review/boundary described; she awoke directly in light, received telepathic messages, then was forced back by the doctor.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Doctor angrily telling her to wake up; later a hospital administrator asked if she remembered anything and she denied it.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was bathed in it." "I felt like I was wrapped in Angel wings." "I had no physical body I just was." "I felt like I was home." "It was a gift from God."
